Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
Draft Transfer policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 
2022 
1. Introduction: 
1.1. This policy may be called “Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security 
Assistants, 2022” hereinafter, referred to as TP-SSA. 
1.2. TP-SSA shall be applicable to all Social Security Assistants (SSA) including the 
Senior Social Security Assistants (SSSA). 
1.3. SSA/SSSA postings shall be governed on the following key principles:- 
i. 
All SSA / SSSA are liable to serve anywhere in the respective States to which 
they are appointed. 
ii. 
 Notwithstanding the above, any SSA/SSSA may be transferred from one 
State to another State or to Headquarters or vice-versa on administrative 
grounds or in public interest. 
1.4. It shall cover all the SSA/SSSA posted at District, Special State, Regional and 
any other office.  
1.5. This policy supersedes the existing guidelines for transfer or rotation or Inter 
Regional (State) Transfer for the cadre of SSA as amended from time to time. 
1.6. The Policy is in response to the direction of the Supreme Court of India as 
contained in the Writ Petition (Civil) No.82 of 2011(T.S.R Subramanian & ORS. 
Vs. Union of India & Ors. Judgement dated 31.10.2013) and the 
communications from the Department of Personnel & Training bearing number 
11013/10/2013-Estt.A dated December 26, 2013, January 09, 2014, June 13, 
2014 as well July 2, 2015. 
1.7. The policy borrows various provisions and contours from the current guidelines 
on rotational transfer as well as the Inter Regional (State) Transfer Policy for the 
cadre of SSA issued vide circular No HRM IV/1(12)2012/KN/VOL II/16469

2 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
dated 11.1.2019 (as amended from time to time), administrative circulars and 
guidelines of Vigilance Division as well as policy applicable to other 
Government Departments, other cadres and also the State Governments. 
2. Salient Features of the Policy 
2.1. The fundamental premise of TP-SSA are fairness & transparency, and through 
it place the SSA Cadre equitably across different posts categories, offices and 
stations.  
2.2. The TP-SSA aims to harmonise divergent objectives of institutional memory, 
avoid developing vested interest, exposure to different aspects of working in 
different post categories across various regions within the State for overall 
growth of SSA Cadre. It is paramount that career pathways of SSA Cadre is 
developed to fulfil the EPF Organisational goals. While observing the guidelines 
of DoP&T, the broad contours of organisational principles for career pathways 
of SSA cadre are laid out as under: - 
i. 
The Nature of work can broadly be categorised into Three distinct Categories: 
Accounts, Administration and Compliance.  
 Accounts Category shall include the work of SSAs / SSSA posted in 
Accounts, Cash and Pension sections.   
 Establishment Category shall include SSA /SSSAs posted in sections 
like administration, legal, coordination, PAC, Facilitation Center, DAK, 
Caretaker section, Grievance section and any other section that are not 
related to compliance machinery or settlement of claims.  
 Compliance Category shall include Compliance, Recovery, Damages 
and any other sections that are related to the compliance machinery. 
ii. 
The SSA / SSSA   are expected to undertake within the service period 
different roles and responsibilities to evolve and mature into a Human 
Resource of value for discharging the various functions of field offices and 
grow into future progression roles for supervisory, enforcement and accounts 
cadres.

3 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
iii. 
For the above, SSA/SSSA are expected to have served within a State at 
various District, Special State and Regional Offices.  
2.3. While serving these roles, SSA cadre should also have an understanding of the 
diversity of geographies, industries and people they serve. Thus, tenures should 
expose them across the State they are assigned to.  
2.4. SSA Cadre will also be undergoing various capacity building and training 
programmes to fulfil the organisational goals and prepare itself for future ready 
workforce. 
2.5. All transfer and postings of SSA Cadre shall be effected by the Competent 
Authority in accordance with the instant TP-SSA.  The Competent Authority will 
be advised by the recommendatory body called “SSA Transfer Committee” 
(SSA-TC). 
2.6. The SSA-TC will use a fair and technology enabled mechanism for prioritising 
transfers and drawing the list of SSA/SSSA with suitability remark for each 
transfer/ post / category.  
2.7. A correct and complete database is a sine qua non for operationalising the TP-
SSA along with a robust IT tool for an end to end computerisation of the entire 
process. HR of EPFO (HQ) as well as Zonal Office and Regional Office shall 
ensure that the database containing the complete placement profiles of all 
SSA/SSSA are regularly updated electronically and made available on Hrsoft. 
The IT Tool shall be harmonised with the criteria for assessing individual 
applications / Transfer as per the TP-SSA. 
2.8. In case the number of SSA/SSSA are less in comparison to the sanctioned 
posts, the ACC Zone (In Charge of State) shall, in consultation with the ACC 
(Zones) & OICs of the Offices in the State, identify the posts that can be 
clubbed as additional charge with the post that are compulsorily required for the 
proper functioning of the concerned office. The compulsorily required posts and 
additional post thereto will be listed. No transfers or rotations will be undertaken 
on the clubbed posts.

4 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
2.9. Each ACC Zone (In Charge of State) before undertaking the exercise stated in 
the Para 2.8 shall fix the number of SSA/SSSA for each office on the basis of 
available workforce in his State and distribute proportionately as per claims 
being received by each office.   
2.10. The transfer policy uses multiple factors to classify each post on the basis of 
Category, Tenure, Station, and Nature of the Post while also assessing 
suitability and Sensitivity. 
2.11. All postings are categorised under concept of Tenure (Time Span, Geography, 
Nature, Category). Thus, a robust system of rotation will be followed based on 
the TP-SSA wherein, beyond a specific tenure SSA cadre will be transferred 
and rotated. 
2.12.  All stations have been divided into three categories as per Government of India 
classification of cities for its employees for the purpose of House Rent 
Allowance (HRA).  Classification of an urban agglomeration, city, town or place 
will change as per Government instruction for the purpose of HRA without such 
changes being incorporated in the TP-SSA. 
2.13. All posts are divided into two categories, namely, Sensitive and Non-Sensitive, 
as identified by CVO in conformity and as per CVC guidelines of 1999 (as 
amended from time to time). The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) 
guidelines on tenure for and rotation between sensitive and non-sensitive posts 
and tenure in sensitive posts shall be strictly observed by the Competent 
Authority.  
2.14. All Annual General Transfer (AGT) and Inter-State Transfer (IST) orders shall 
be issued as per time schedules of this Policy. The other applications or 
vacancies arising during the period that is outside AGT / IST will be screened 
on a regular basis to be decided by the Competent Authority. 
2.15. All grievances arising out of transfers shall be addressed in a time bound 
manner in accordance with the provisions of this TP-SSA. However, leave at 
credit of any kind as available may be sanctioned to enable the official to join 
new place of posting in case of IST.

5 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
2.16. Composite Transfer Grant, Joining Time and other benefits pursuant to transfer 
shall not be admitted, in cases where request for transfer is made and the same 
is allowed except in case of tenure postings under AGT.  
2.17. A SSA/SSSA transferred as per the TP-SSA norms on Inter State Transfer 
basis shall be eligible to apply for the various Limited Departmental Competitive 
Examinations in the various cadres only in his/her parent State where he/she 
holds his /her seniority / lien. 
2.18. The AGT / IST will have following numeric restrictions to maintain proper 
functioning and efficiency of the organisation:- 
i. 
For Inter State Transfers, the requests for transfer out from the State shall not 
exceed 5% of the sanctioned strength under Direct Recruitment quota of that 
State as on 31st March of that year.  
ii. 
For IST, the total number of SSA to be transferred to a State shall not exceed 
50% of the vacancies under Direct Recruitment quota in that State as on 31st 
March of that year. 
iii. 
Any discretionary transfers on account of administrative grounds or 
exigencies beyond the TP-SSA norms of post Category, Tenure, Nature and 
Geography for AGT will be limited to 5% of the total transfers made. 
iv. 
 Similarly, the requests received from the SSA Cadre officials on account of 
compassionate grounds will also be dealt with restricted to 10% of the total 
transfers.  
3. The Competent Authority 
3.1. The Competent Authority for considering applications for transfer, placement or 
overstay and effecting all transfers and placement or disposing such application 
from an SSA shall be as under: 
S.No. 
Authority 
Extent of description of power 
1.

For Inter State Transfers of SSAs on 
request basis.

Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
 
2. 
Additional Central Provident 
Fund Commissioner (Zone)(In 
Charge of State) 
For all SSA/SSSAs within the State. 
3. 
RPFC (OIC) Regional Office  
Rotation transfer of SSA/SSSAs within 
the office as per norms of TP-SSA 
only. 
3.2. Notwithstanding the above, CPFC shall have full powers for transfer, rotation 
and IST of any SSA/SSSA.  
3.3. The Competent Authority for making the transfer will duly secure the advice and 
consider the recommendations of SSA-TC and exercise its powers in 
accordance with the TP-SSA. 
3.4. The SSA-TC will be a Three member Committee at the various levels   
comprising as follows : 
i. 
SSA-TC-Inter_State - At HQ Level- ACC(HR), Senior Most ACC at 
Headquarters and the RPFC-I (HR) as Convenor of the Committee.  
ii. 
SSA-TC–Zone - At Zonal Level - In case of Multi Zone State, it will comprise 
of  ACCs of the Zone and senior-most RPFC-I. In case of single Zone State, 
two senior-most RPFC I. In both the cases the convenor of the Committee 
shall be RPFC-I of Zonal Office/ RPFC I of nearest RO of the Zone. This 
Committee shall not include the ACC(Zone In Charge of STATE) 
iii. 
SSA-TC-Region - At Regional Office Level – comprising of OIC, RPFC/APFC 
(Admin)  and seniormost EO/AO of the Region  
3.5. All instances where advice of the SSA-TC is not adhered to or rejected by the 
Competent Authority, the reasons in full shall be recorded for such decisions.  
4. Tenure, Rotation and Classification of Geographies

7 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
4.1. For the purpose of AGT and rotation transfer within office, a tenure means 
continuous posting in a particular post (seat), after which an Official shall be 
liable for transfer.  The tenure for each category shall be two years.  
i. 
Each SSA in a block of three tenures within an office shall not be posted 
continuously in Accounts category. 
ii. 
Each SSA/SSSA shall not have more than 2 continuous tenures in a District 
Office. 
iii. 
Each SSA/SSSA shall not have more than 3 continuous tenures in a Regional 
Office.  
iv. 
Each SSA/SSSA shall have a maximum of 5 tenures within a Region.   
v. 
Each SSA/SSSA shall not have more than 7 continuous tenures in a Station.  
vi. 
It is desirable that SSA/SSSA should, for all round holistic development do 
tenures at each of X, Y and Z  category stations. Special attention may be 
given towards this aspect by the competent Authority. 
4.2. For the purpose of IST, following principles shall be followed :- 
i. 
A tenure means continuous posting of two years in a particular post.   
ii. 
An SSA who has completed at least 4 tenures (eight years including period 
spent on probation) in the Parent State shall be eligible for applying for Inter 
State Transfer. Provided no vigilance case is pending against the applicant at 
the time of forwarding of request as well as issue of the transfer order of the 
official concerned. 
iii. 
The Competent Authority may grant relaxation in service period as prescribed 
above in respect of an SSA/SSSA where the request for the transfer has 
been made on the basis of prevalent DoP&T guidelines. 
iv. 
An SSA/SSSA can in her/his career in the cadre of SSA apply only once for 
IST.

8 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
v. 
Inter State Transfer will be on lien basis and for not more 3 Tenures ( a period 
of 6 years).  
vi. 
The period may be further extended by Competent Authority (ACC (HQ HR) 
on case to case basis by a period not exceeding 1 year. 
4.3. The period of Tenure shall be counted from the date of joining and not from the 
date of the order.  
4.4.  Tenure of posting in North-Eastern Region (NER) and Andaman & Nicobar 
Islands shall be guided by the policy of Government of India on transfer and 
tenure for such places.  
4.5. Posting of spouses/ Persons with Disability etc: Posting of spouses and persons 
with Disability / Persons who are caregivers of Disabled Dependents etc shall 
be regulated as per Govt. of India policy on the matter as applicable from time 
to time.  
4.6. 
The norms for transfer in respect of Officials due to retire within two years to the 
extent administratively feasible shall be guided by the norms of DoP&T. 
4.7. 
All the above tenure, rotation norms shall be strictly adhered to unless in 
administrative exigencies and broader public interest requiring approval of the 
Competent Authority.   
5. Transfer procedure: 
5.1. 
The Transfers are categorised into two Categories of Annual General Transfers 
(AGT), Inter State Transfer (IST) and Transfers other than AGT (Non AGT).  
Annual General Transfers: - 
5.2. 
AGT is defined as the annual exercise of examining the tenure and placement 
of SSA/SSSA and to order transfer or permit overstay of those who have 
completed tenures either on post category, station, geographies, or nature of 
the post tenure.  
5.3. 
Transfer in pursuance to promotion shall not form part of the AGT.

9 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
5.4. 
In case the number of SSA/SSSA are less in comparison to the sanctioned 
posts, the ACC Zone ( In Charge of State) shall, in consultation with the 
ACC(Zones) & OICs of the Offices in the State, identify the posts that can be 
clubbed as additional charge with the post that are compulsorily required for the 
proper functioning of the concerned office. The compulsorily required posts and 
additional post thereto will be listed. No transfers or rotations will be undertaken 
on the clubbed posts. 
 
5.5. 
Before options for AGT i.e. Inter Office transfer within a State are called, SSA-
TC-Zone will undertake the following pre-AGT assessment and freeze the 
information: 
i. 
Identify posts wherein the postings are to be made compulsorily for smooth 
functioning of the office. This shall be done category-wise and office wise in 
the State. 
ii. 
Identify posts that are under zone of consideration of transfer from Office and 
/OR Station based on the norms laid in Para 4 of TP-SSA and thus are 
available for AGT.  
iii. 
Prepare a list of SSA/SSSA who would be under consideration of AGT as per 
TP-SSA norms. 
iv. 
Develop a list of posts / stations available for transfers from the above set of 
information. 
5.6. 
All options for transfer to an office shall be received through online-IT tool. An 
SSA/SSSA who is due for transfer shall be able to exercise option of five offices 
in the State within the norms of the TP-SSA.  
5.7. 
Any SSA/SSSA who is seeking transfer, in relaxation of the policy (whether due 
for transfer or not) shall apply for an Office with the reasons and evidence 
thereof. These shall be accorded points as per the priority matrix under 
Annexure -I. 
5.8. 
SSA-TC-ZONE shall take the following action:-

10 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
i. 
For Compassionate transfers, SSA-TC-Zone shall, within the limit of 10% of 
total transfers, take the topmost requests and tabulate on the basis of 
available offices and mark all applications as per priority matrix.  
ii. 
Thereafter each application will be categorised on the basis of first option. It 
will identify those Offices for which no options are received. 
iii. 
In case the number of options are higher than the number of vacancies for an 
office, a list will be prepared with following numeric rubric; 
i. 
First priority shall be given based on grounds of Disability. 
ii. 
Second priority shall be given to those who are due to retire within 2 
years. 
iii. 
Third priority to those whose requests are based on Spouses ground. 
iv. 
Fourth priority shall be based on who has served the least period in  
that category of station ( ‘X’ , ‘Y’ ‘Z’) 
v. 
In case of similarly placed officials, option shall be considered in the 
order of seniority with first preference to senior.  
vi. 
However, each such consideration shall be subject to suitability and 
sensitivity of that post. 
vii. 
For the offices and officials that are not considered after running the 
iteration of first options, similar exercise will be undertaken for second 
option, third option, fourth option and fifth option in that order.  
viii. 
For the offices and officials that are not considered after running the 
fifth iteration, the SSA-TC-Zone will examine over all profile and 
recommend them for transfers such that all posts are considered. 
While doing so SSA-TC-Zone will try to accommodate the nearest of 
the available Offices given in any of the options.

11 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
5.9. 
Head Quarters will oversee an IT tool which supports categorisation of each 
post as per (i) Category (ii) Sensitivity (Vigilance Angle) , (iii) locational  and 
publish them for option calling.   
Rotation Transfers within the Region:- 
5.10. Rotation transfers are subset of AGT and shall be done after IST and AGT are 
undertaken. SSA-TC-REGION shall take the following actions; 
i. 
Before Intra Office rotation is done, SSA-TC-REGION will identify posts 
wherein the postings are to be made compulsorily for smooth functioning of 
the office. This shall be done category-wise. 
ii. 
Identify posts that are under zone of consideration of rotation transfer from 
their current seats based on the norms laid in Para 4 of TP-SSA and thus are 
available for rotation transfer.  
iii. 
Prepare a list of officials who would be under consideration of Intra Office 
Rotation as per TP-SSA norms. 
iv. 
Develop a list of category wise posts / stations available for rotation transfers 
from the above set of information. 
v. 
Recommend SSA/SSSA for each category of post taking into consideration 
the norms of the TP-SSA for posting within the Office among the three 
categories of posts, keeping in sensitivity (Vigilance Angle) for each category 
and administrative requirements. 
vi. 
In case the number of Officials eligible for posting in a particular category are 
more than the number of posts available, the priority for shifting from 
Accounts shall be given over those of other categories. 
vii. 
First priority should be given to an SSA/SSSA who has served the least 
period in that Category. 
viii. 
An SSA/SSSA should not be allotted the same jurisdiction, specially in 
Accounts Category to the extent possible.

12 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
5.11. The above shall be prepared with the help of IT tool as per various norms and 
parameters of the TP-SSA and the SSA-TC shall prepare the final 
recommendation to be submitted to the Competent Authority. 
5.12. Each AGT shall consist of two lists of transferees: (a) SSA/SSSA who are due 
for transfer on completion of category / station / Geographical Tenure and (b) 
SSA/SSSA transferred on request / compassionate ground. 
5.13. When a certain number of SSA/SSSA are due for moving out of an Office / 
station to a new Office / station or to new postings in the same station for 
reason of having completed their tenure but cannot be so moved due to 
inadequate number of vacancies available at the destination station/office, the 
SSA/SSSA who has served for longer periods will be moved first. 
Inter State Transfers on Requests  
5.14. Before options for Inter State Transfers are called, SSA-TC-INTER_STATE will 
undertake the following pre-IST assessment and freeze the information: 
i. 
Identify number of posts available in each State for transfer-in as per TP-SSA 
Norms Office wise.  
ii. 
Identify the maximum number of SSA/SSSA who shall be considered for 
transfer out from each State in accordance with the TP-SSA norms. 
iii. 
Publish such information online for option calling through online Portal. 
iv. 
All options for transfer shall be for an office and shall be received through 
online-IT tool. An SSA/SSSA who requests for transfer shall be able to 
exercise option of five offices within the norms of the TP-SSA.  
v. 
These shall be accorded points as per the priority matrix under Annexure -I. 
vi. 
The requests so submitted shall be routed through concerned OIC and ACC 
(Zone) through the Online Portal.  
vii. 
The concerned OIC at Regional Office shall take following actions on each 
request received :-

13 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
a) Verify the eligibility of the applicant as per the TP-SSA norms. If not 
eligible, even as per relaxation, shall reject the same with remarks. 
b) Verify the documents uploaded from original. If wrong or incorrect 
document is uploaded, the same shall be returned to the SSA/SSSA 
for amendment / correction in request. 
c) Upload the Vigilance Clearance Certificate / Status of the SSA/SSSA 
in the online portal. 
d)  Forward the request to ACC (Zone) with remarks/ recommendation, if 
eligible and documents uploaded are verified from original alongwith 
the Vigilance status. 
viii. 
The concerned ACC(ZONE) shall take following actions on each request 
forwarded by the OIC (RO) :- 
a) May return to OIC(RO) for correct document upload; or 
b) Reject the application with remarks; or  
c) Forward the request to HQ with or without recommendations.  
5.15. SSA-TC-INTER_STATE shall take the following actions:- 
i. 
Prepare the list of candidates eligible for transfer out of the State from the 
total requests received from the State. Candidates not found eligible shall not 
be considered for transfer.   
ii. 
Arrange the list of candidates in the descending order of points obtained as 
per priority Matrix in ANNEXURE.  
iii. 
In case there is a tie between applicants, the length of service in the  SSA 
cadre with reference to the date of appointment in the State shall be given 
priority and thereafter based on the seniority. 
iv. 
Finalise the list of SSA/SSSA based on above for transfer out limited to the 
total number of requests that can be considered for transfer out from that 
State as per Para 2.17.

14 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
v. 
Thereafter the TP-SSA-INTER_STATE shall list all the first options on the 
matrix of offices state wise.  
vi. 
In case the number of options are higher than the number of vacancies for an 
office, prepare the list of options received for each office. 
vii. 
Such list to be arranged in the descending order as per the points obtained as 
per Priority Matrix. In case of similarly placed candidates priority to be given 
to length of service and then to age with SSA/SSSA with longer service and 
born earlier given priority. 
viii. 
For the Officials that are not considered after running the iteration of first 
options similar exercise will be undertaken for second option, third option, 
fourth option and fifth option in that order.  
ix. 
For the SSA/SSA that are not considered after running the fifth iteration, the 
SSA-TC-INTER_STATE will examine over all profile and recommend them for 
the nearest available Office given in any of the options.

Transfers other than AGT & IST 
5.17. Premature Transfers on Administrative Grounds 
i. 
In case of an Administrative Exigency the Competent Authority may transfer a 
SSA Cadre official without the recommendation of SSA-TC.  
 
ii. 
Any order for premature transfer shall be done by the Competent Authority for 
good and sufficient reasons to be recorded in writing. 
 
5.18. Transfers on Requests within State 
i. 
Every application made for transfer, placement or overstay may be made 
directly to the Competent Authority through electronic medium. The same shall

16 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
be referred to the SSA-TC and the SSA-TC shall submit its recommendations to 
the Competent Authority as per the policy guidelines. 
 
ii. 
 The competent authority shall take action on the recommendations of SSA-TC-
Zone within a reasonable period from the date of receipt of such application. 
 
5.19. Postings on Promotion and Appointment 
 
i. 
The norm is posting on promotion that would entail mandatory change from the 
category of post where the official was working before promotion and if required 
change of office in case there is no option for change in category including 
change in Station.  
 
ii. 
Transfers on promotion shall be made by the Competent Authority as specified 
at Para 3. 
 
iii. 
SSA-TC shall examine the overall profile of Officials and to the extent possible 
within norms of Para 4 of TP-SSA, will give its recommendations for posting of 
each SSA/SSSA being promoted.  
6.  Redressal of Grievances:  
6.1. 
Every SSA/SSSA aggrieved by an order of transfer has a right to make 
application before the Competent Authority within three days of issue of such 
order.  
6.2. 
Grievance from a SSA/SSSA whose request for transfer is not heeded within 
reasonable time can also make such a request.  
6.3. 
All such grievances shall be received online through HrSoft.  
6.4. 
The Competent Authority shall refer all such grievances in respect of following 
instances :-

17 
Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
i. 
Where grievance is against decision of transfer / no transfer by RPFC 
(OIC) – to RPFC/APFC(ADM) and two senior-most Group B officers 
posted in the office. 
ii. 
Where grievance is against decision of transfer / no transfer by 
ACC(ZONE) (In Charge of State) – to two senior-most RPFC-I in the 
Zone. 
iii. 
Where grievance is against decision of transfer / no transfer by ACC 
(HQ HR) – to two senior-most ACCs in Head Office. 
6.5. 
The ACCs/ RPFCs as at Para 6.4, after taking considered view and subjecting it 
to suitability and sensitivity considerations, may advise the Competent Authority 
on the merits of the case.  
6.6. 
The Competent Authority may on the basis on above advise and other 
administrative considerations dispose the grievance.  
6.7. 
The decision of the Competent Authority shall be communicated to the 
concerned SSA/SSSA through HrSoft. 
6.8. 
All such grievances outside AGT shall be disposed off in reasonable time frame 
normally not exceeding three months. 
6.9. 
When an SSA/SSSA is transferred prematurely or in deviation from the TP-
SSA, he/she can prefer to represent or appeal before the Central Provident 
Fund Commissioner against such transfer who shall decide the representation.  
7.  Miscellaneous: 
7.1. 
The basis of the recommendations in terms of norms and justifications used by 
SSA-TC shall be placed on the HrSoft.  
7.2. 
All subsequent amendments to the TP-SSA shall be incorporated in this Policy 
and a consolidated Transfer Policy shall be duly published on the web site.  
7.3. 
RPFC I (HRM) / RPFC I (ZONAL OFFICE) (STATE)/ RPFC (ADM) (RO) shall 
serve as nodal officer and shall be responsible to initiate the process of AGT as

Draft Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022 
per timelines. The Nodal officer shall also be charged with the duty of seeking 
views of stakeholders regarding difficulties faced by them or improvements to 
be made to this Policy and to compile and refer such cases to Headquarters. 
7.4. 
Residential Accommodation of the Board: Any transfer ordered in public interest 
beyond the schedule prescribed shall entitle the employee for the continued 
retention of the residential accommodation owned by the Board till the end of 
the financial year in which such transfer is ordered or till the period prescribed 
under Residence Rules applicable for the employees of the Board, whichever is 
later. Under exceptional circumstances relaxation to retain accommodation can 
be given by the Competent Authority.  
7.5. 
Power to remove difficulties: 
i. 
In case of any doubt regarding the provisions of the TP-SSA, the matter shall be 
placed before the CPFC for consideration. The decision of CPFC shall be final in 
regard to matters thus referred. The same shall be placed before the Central 
Board of Trustees in its next meeting for information. 
 
ii. 
In case of any difficulty in the implementation of the Policy that may be noticed, 
amendments may be recommended in the TP-SSA and placed before the Central 
Board for approval. Each such amendment of the Policy along with a consolidated 
Transfer Policy, after incorporating such changes, shall be formally notified and 
shall also be placed in the public domain.
